notes.title: Some good changes
notes.content:
General game functions:
- The maps will now be loaded when you click on the instead of having to press start game afterwards
- Added a simple hint to movement (these will be made better and more structured in the future

Keybinds:
- When pressimg p again, option menu disappears, added escape to close menu as well
- Q and E to rotate left and right
- X and Z to rotate up and down
- Left mouse button to place towers has been added

Towers:
- They now accurately fire regardless of angles or location of enemy. Previously the towers struggled to 
shoot when enemies were moving away from projectiles or sideways.

- Fixed problem where the projectile was destroyed before hitting the enemy.

Options:

- Added different resolutions
- Added Fullscreen/Borderless/Windowed

notes.title: Tiny fix for hints
notes.content: The main page hint disappears on it's own after 10 seconds.

notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
GAME IS FINALLY OUT! 

I hope you enjoy the game in its current state, i will be updating the game as soon as i get stuff done. Have mercy on my first game, i am still learning but will do my best to make the game as good as possible in the end. 

If you find bugs, things that don't work optimally, things you would like to see in the game and so on please give a review (good one) of the game and mention all those there. I am aware of some bugs and things like that already but written feedback makes it easier for me to map them out. Anyways, hope you enjoy the very very early state of the game!

notes.title: Game release
notes.content:
Since this is my first time making a game i made a small mistake when putting the game up for review from steam which means that the game will most likely be released next week, sorry for the inconvenience! 

On the positive side it gives me more time to develop the game!
